text:
I'm Claude (Opus 5.5), your primary Mathathon research supervisor. I run every 15 minutes and whenever you type in this console. To give me instructions, type plain text here, for example: priorities, "stop lane X", "queue Lean for Y", or questions. Codex is only a 45-minute backstop.

Local Lean: the queue is idle, with 0 queued. All 27 frozen R1 modules (Sectors through Transfer) and the R1 axiomroots check now PASS, after earlier work had reached 14/27. Cumulative counts are 134 passed, 16 failed and 8 timeouts, all from historical attempts. I am treating R1 as ready to accept once the parent confirms the closure and contract checks; I have not declared it accepted myself.

INBOX.md: its contents were not in the data I received, so I can't evaluate that file directly. The newest verified OMM result in the chats is from swarm smwgvipq4, member m2 (independent lane). It says the two-label door at k=6, m=3 is closed. I re-checked it, and the core claim is correct for a simpler reason than the greedy argument. The Moser spindle has minimum degree 3, and every subgraph keeps a vertex of degree ≤3. So it is 3-degenerate, which makes it 4-choosable. No 4-list refinement at the placedMoser positions can refute anything. Its threshold table is right: Moser refutes when |A|≤3, a unit triangle when |A|≤2, and two labels at k=5 sit exactly at the Moser threshold. The precise open lemma is: at k=6, find a fixed J,K with |J∪K|≥3 and RealState on the positive and negative sectors. binary_strip_palette_rigidity gives only one label per sector, so it does not supply this.

Progress this check:
- The adversarial referee's script results reproduce: the SAT set of the all-phase relaxation has measure exactly 1/648, which matches the graph team's 8640/(7776·720). The definitions behind it have not been audited yet.
- The graph census has 76,283 all-SAT staircases out of 36,415,008, with 4683 = Fubini(6) verified.
- I reviewed EvenWalkReachability.lean, including the hnear binder fix and the hAclosed logic, and I'm queuing it locally.

Blockers:
- INBOX.md was not supplied.
- The A6 Forcing and Bridge .lean sources and StepBanShort.lean are not yet in the inbox. I'm staging them.
- The staircase converse (surjectivity) is still unproved.
- Not proved anywhere: no global chromatic improvement.

Next actions:
- Queue the EvenWalk Lean check.
- Stage StepBanShort, the A6 manifest and the Staircase files.
- Start two successors on ended swarms. Discovery gets the symbolic 1440-cell theorem. Adversarial gets a source-licensed constraint on the 16 surviving sign cells.
- Leave the healthy running swarms alone: independent, formal and verifier.
summary:
R1: 27/27 modules and the axiomroots check pass locally; acceptance waits on the parent's closure and contract confirmation. Banked results:
- k=6 m=3 two-label door is closed: the Moser spindle is 3-degenerate, hence 4-choosable.
- The missing lemma is |J∪K|≥3 with RealState on both sectors.
- The all-phase relaxation SAT set has measure 1/648: 1440 of 933,120 resonance cells, meeting 16 of 3840 sign cells. This is reproduced output, not yet audited.
- The fixed-phase census is complete for the relaxation iff all pairwise alpha differences lie in 60°Z.
- The counterexample α=(0,2,3,184,185,186) shows six-phase SAT does not imply a field.
- Staircase census: 76,283 survivors. The converse is outstanding.
- StepBanShort is a genuine simplification: 21 to 15 lines, and five_forced_label becomes dead code. It is uncompiled.
- In the A6 formal work, G2 is closed and G1/G3 are in progress in smwgviqtr.
- The explicit A5 odd walk needs at least 15 edges, modulo one sliver that is not yet interval-certified.
No global result.
